title: asyncio 协程的交错顺序是确定的
expected_output:
交错序列: ['start-A', 'start-B', 'start-C', 'end-A', 'end-B', 'end-C']
A 最先启动: True
启动顺序 == A,B,C: True
结束顺序 == A,B,C: True
code:
import asyncio


# asyncio 是单线程协作式调度：
# 不遇到 await 就不会切换。sleep(0) 是「主动让出」的最小单位，
# 所以交错顺序是**确定性**的。

log = []


async def worker(name):
    log.append("start-" + name)
    await asyncio.sleep(0)          # 让出控制权
    log.append("end-" + name)


async def main():
    await asyncio.gather(worker("A"), worker("B"), worker("C"))


asyncio.run(main())
print("交错序列:", log)
print("A 最先启动:", log[0] == "start-A")
print("启动顺序 == A,B,C:", [x for x in log if x.startswith("start")] ==
      ["start-A", "start-B", "start-C"])
print("结束顺序 == A,B,C:", [x for x in log if x.startswith("end")] ==
      ["end-A", "end-B", "end-C"])
